title: Cosmic Wanderers
description: A surreal night scene shows two hikers with backpacks and walking sticks standing on a winding path through a purple field of flowers and eyes. In the sky, a large intricate cosmic entity composed of multiple eyes, geometric patterns, and a central diamond shape floats near a red ringed planet with symbols.
